condition.instanceCountMeaning: configured maximum; batch overlap intervals recorded separately

method.focus: First observed departure or different element focus; native poll intervals are used only with bounded IPC clocks. Negative intervals are retained rather than clamped.
method.visibility: Last preserved false sample to first true sample; the nominal 25 ms interval is not substituted for missing polls.
method.predicate: Fresh sentinel after the five-second observation; it does not establish the predicate at the first focus transition.
method.provider: Actual command-associated request candidates, client/server causal clock bounds and strict containment of the j keydown. Ambiguity remains explicit.
